description: No code path (server function or tracked migration) inserts a row into opportunity_commissions. UI copy claims it happens automatically on purchase/delivery. Migration history only goes back to 2026-08-17 so an untracked DB trigger cannot be ruled out statically -- needs a live check against the actual Supabase project. If no such trigger exists, the entire partner-commission lifecycle has no working create step.

withdrawOpportunity only checks for a Postgres error, never affected-row-count. RLS policy opp_partner_update only allows the update when status=brouillon OR owner_side=partenaire, but the button is shown for envoyee/en_cours_analyse/offre_envoyee/en_negociation/refusee where owner_side is normally wilmet. In that common case zero rows match, no error is raised, and the handler returns {ok:true} anyway -- user sees a false success toast, row is unchanged.

adminRejectBuyerLead accepts a reason param from the reject dialog but never writes it to any column -- no matching column exists on buyer_leads. Contrast with the opportunity close-reason flow (adminCloseOpportunity), which does persist correctly.
Filter reads vehicle_opportunities.vehicle_type, but the creating wizard (/opportunities/new) never writes that column -- new opportunities are always null here and can never match this filter.
Routes to /chercher-un-vehicule generic wizard with no vehicle id/reference carried over; wizard has no field to receive one. Unclear if manual triage is intentional or context should be pre-filled.

Product decision: remove or keep as a fallback for when the auto-insert fails.
No delete or archive endpoint exists for sale_listings anywhere in sale-listings.functions.ts. 'Retirer' only sets status=retiree (soft-close). No code path to remove a wrongly-created draft listing.

Unlike every sibling route in this app, this file has no beforeLoad at all -- any authenticated user can navigate here directly. No actual data leak (listDemandOpportunities re-checks role server-side and returns nothing to non-staff), but inconsistent with the pattern every sibling route uses.

Client-side filter only covers the first 60 already-fetched listings; listPublicVehicles supports a server-side q param that this page never sends. Not broken today, becomes a real gap once the catalog exceeds 60 published listings.

Gate only activates after its own query resolves, so the full wizard UI can flash briefly for a non-seller account before the restriction screen swaps in. Writes are still protected server-side/RLS regardless -- UX gap, not a data exposure.

Dependency check before delete only covers vehicle_opportunities/demand_opportunities/buyer_leads assignment; does not check staff_group_members. Whether the DB has an FK cascade on that table isn't visible in generated types -- needs live schema check.
Deletes only from staff_groups; whether staff_group_members rows cascade-delete depends on an FK definition not visible in generated types. Needs live schema check.
No per-request detail, edit, or cancel route exists for buyers (unlike sellers, who have /opportunities/$id). May be intentional (staff-mediated only) -- needs product sign-off.

None of these core money-path entities support a real hard delete anywhere in the app -- only status-transition soft-closes. Likely intentional for audit-trail preservation, but needs explicit product sign-off rather than being assumed.

Selects vehicle_opportunities by id with no partenaire_id filter in the query itself -- ownership is enforced entirely by the Postgres RLS SELECT policy (opp_select_scoped). Policy reads correctly scoped on inspection, but since it is the only line of defense, needs live/staging confirmation rather than a static pass.

updateDemandStage, linkVehicleMatch, suggestVehiclesForDemand, getDemandOpportunity call no app-level role check (only requireSupabaseAuth), unlike nearly every other server function in the codebase. Enforcement relies entirely on RLS policies; the client used is caller-JWT-scoped so RLS applies -- probably safe but needs live confirmation.
No role check beyond being logged in, unlike the sibling completeOpportunityActivity handler which does call assertAdmin. Needs live RLS confirmation on opportunity_activities.

opportunity_documents.storage_path and ocr_scan_sources.storage_path are read/written as plain text columns, but a full repo-wide search for every .storage.from(...) call found exactly one Storage bucket in use anywhere (vehicle-photos). No code path uploads a file to Storage for either feature. Salma confirmed (2026-08-24) she has never tested document upload and isn't sure it works. Likely an unfinished feature rather than a security or data issue -- needs exercising in the Phase 0.5 functional walkthrough once the app is testable again.
